🧙‍♀️ Emoji Games

A White Witch spinoff.

From The White Witch™
(@TheWhiteWitchTM)

Politics broke me, so I started porting old games.
Then I got bored of those too and decided the emojis needed their own corner.

This is that corner. It opened on 12 October 2026.

No accounts.
No “please create an account to play a 50-year-old idea with pictures.”
No quiet sponsors.
Argue with the code, not the caption.

On the shelf

Click one and play it in the browser. The catalog can be searched and filtered. The release notes are the log of what showed up on which day.

  • 🏓 Pong — first to 5, you against the machine.
  • 🐍 Snake — eat, grow, and don’t hit the furniture.
  • 🚀 Galaxy Hunt — clear an 8×8 galaxy before the stardate runs out.
  • 🌲 Adventureland — thirteen treasures, one hollow stump.
  • 🏴‍☠️ Pirate Adventure — leave the flat, find the island, keep the gold.
  • 🗡️ Rogue — six floors, then the amulet.
  • 🗡️ Hack — rooms, corridors, and things that walk toward you.
  • 🤖 Trump Super Intelligence — a chatbot with a face and a lot of opinions.
  • 🐂 The Oregon Trail — five names, a wagon, and the road to the Willamette.
  • 🖥️ Witch I — a 40-column machine. It speaks WASIC.
